action: Consistent snapshot of the live Bifrost request log to the vault. Nothing deleted, nothing on the source touched.
method: sqlite3 .backup against a read-only handle — not cp, because the database is in WAL mode and a plain copy can capture a torn state.

verification.note: Opened with immutable=1. A plain read-only open failed with SQLITE_CANTOPEN because SQLite wanted to create -wal/-shm sidecars next to the archive; the data was never the problem.

why_this_matters: Decision 6 (log retention) can now be taken without risking the evidence base for the GQ-008 and GQ-002 claims. The reversible half — archive first — is done; the irreversible half — delete rows — remains a decision I am not making.
disk_effect: None yet. This adds 3.4GB to the vault (3.8Ti free) and reclaims nothing from the root disk, by design.
